points.description: States that the data rate (after compression) must not exceed the channel capacity / bandwidth of the communication link.
points.partial_credit: Half if only vaguely refers to channel or bandwidth limits.

points.description: States that the channel capacity should be fully utilized and/or the maximum quality of the data should be preserved (e.g. minimal distortion).
points.partial_credit: Half if only one of the two is mentioned vaguely.

rubric.notes: Full marks for covering the main ideas in any wording: rate must stay within channel capacity, and the channel should be used fully while keeping quality high. Give 1 mark if only one idea is clearly stated, or if both are stated very vaguely. Give 0 for unrelated answers. Extra remarks do not cost marks.
